content:
## What is RoomFlip?

RoomFlip.io is an AI-powered interior design tool. Upload a photo of any room, pick a style, and the AI generates a redesigned version while keeping the room's structure intact.

## How it works

The tool uses image-to-image AI models to transform room photos. Upload your image, select a style (minimalist, scandinavian, industrial, bohemian, etc.), and get results in about 30 seconds.

The AI preserves room layout — walls, windows, doors stay in place. Furniture, colors, and decor change to match the selected style.

## Use cases

Renters looking for inspiration without committing. Homeowners planning renovations. Interior design students exploring concepts. Real estate agents staging properties virtually.

## Pricing

Free tier with 3 credits. Paid packs starting at $5 for 20 transformations.

## Verdict

RoomFlip won't replace a professional interior designer, but for quick inspiration and visualization, it hits the mark. The structure preservation is impressive — results look like realistic redesigns, not random AI art.
